# Project Folder Navigation

The ["Steering Committee" project folder](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1_7i1EqAp4TvgSZxO_FA-is7oXZRBTMpI?usp=drive_link) can be found in your "Shared Drives" folder in Google Drive. This folder contains important documents and resources related to the Steering Committee's activities, including meeting notes, agendas, and other relevant materials.

The following folders contain the most relevant resources:

- [Call agenda/notes](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NjVdQj96jFzS6AT4mmmUDOfzOWjJ-XFb?usp=drive_link)
- [Conference abstracts](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OttjRicX3xLWFcr7LFEayJw24Rx4tdMi?usp=drive_link)
- [Implementation plans](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RV41HzBYlmdTVKS8jM8KsVTeA7F0guvp)
- [Manuscripts](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/171h56xW60OILChiKdVQr1ya4Z4UVwoVg?usp=drive_link)

# Meeting Notes

[Meeting notes](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1z2qqoACJtE926DidgapLivb_grDxeT9vcoaox5pYG48/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.22qfa5vlehbi) from previous Steering Committee meetings are editable by the Steering Committee and internal NOAA HQ team. These notes provide a record of discussions, decisions, and action items from past meetings.

Each meeting, a new section is added to the document with the date and agenda items discussed. Steering Committee members are encouraged to review the notes from previous meetings to stay informed about ongoing discussions and initiatives.
